title: WHAT IF YOU WENT BACK TO 2010 WITH $100?

segments.line: It starts with Mo.
He doesn't mean to tell anyone. He just tells his cousin.
Who tells a friend.
Who posts it on a forum. 'Kid predicted the World Cup. Says he's from the future. '
Nobody believes it, of course.
Except one person.
A week later, a black car is parked across the street.
It's there in the morning.
It's there after school.
And then, one afternoon, a man in a grey suit is sitting in your kitchen, drinking tea with Mum.
He's polite. He has a briefcase.
He knows your name. He knows Ellie's name. He
even knows Mum takes two sugars, before she tells him.
His shoes are spotless. His
phone is the thinnest phone you've seen in 2011. Thinner than an iPhone 4.
You've seen a phone like that before, just not in 2011.
'You bought ten thousand bitcoins for a hundred dollars, ' he says. 'In May 2010. Nobody did that. Nobody knew to. ' He
opens the briefcase. It's full of cash.
Fifty thousand dollars. In 2011, for a kid, that's insane.
'For the coins, ' he says. 'All of them. Tonight. '
Mum's eyes go wide. She doesn't know what bitcoin is. But she knows what fifty thousand dollars is.
Right now, your coins are worth more than that. But only on paper, and only until the crash. And
then the man says something that makes your blood go cold. He
leans in, and he says it quietly, so only you can hear.
'I know what they're worth in 2024. '
